protocol: Resume full small ViT, manual Adam moments, training chains and PRNG exactly. Fixed 1000 additional updates, no early stopping or audit-based checkpoint selection. No change of learning rate, model or training sample count. Audits run only after training; fresh independent streams separately remeasure parent and terminal state. Each state uses 3 x 32 chains x 32 snapshots = 3072 records. Audit seeds never enter training. No remote jobs, ED, OF extension or production release.
inference: Terminal-minus-parent differences are UNPAIRED. Report chain-block bootstrap intervals, chain-mean SE, independent-stream agreement, split-chain energy Rhat, half-run drift, imaginary mean and variance-tail contributions. These diagnostics do not certify mixing. Do not interpret random-high-energy initial variance as a ground-state target. No automated claim of a frontier/SU2 win.
budget: 1000 updates per lattice; CPU planning estimate 9 min triangular + 5 min square, plus independent audits, compilation and checkpoint I/O. Finite-value or integrity failure halts with last valid checkpoint; it does not license a parameter change or an automatic longer run.
